title: 2009 HMMT February Guts Problem 23
statement: The roots of \(z^{6}+z^{4}+z^{2}+1=0\) are the vertices of a convex polygon in the complex plane. Find the sum of the squares of the side lengths of the polygon.

solutions.text: Factoring the polynomial as \(\left(z^{4}+1\right)\left(z^{2}+1\right)=0\), we find that the 6 roots are \(e^{ \pm i \pi / 4}\), \(e^{ \pm i \pi / 2}, e^{ \pm i 3 \pi / 4}\). The calculation then follows from the Law of Cosines or the distance formula.
